{"id":1045804987,"question_id":223,"lang":"csharp","lang_name":"C#","time":"2 years, 10 months","timestamp":1694363708,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"19 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1045804987/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Rectangle Area","memory":"28.3 MB","code":"public class Solution {\n    public int ComputeArea(int ax1, int ay1, int ax2, int ay2, int bx1, int by1, int bx2, int by2) {\n        int area1 = (ax2-ax1)*(ay2-ay1);\n        \n        int area2 = (bx2-bx1)*(by2-by1);\n        \n        int overlap = 0;\n        \n        if(ax1<bx2 && ax2>bx1 && ay1<by2 && ay2>by1){\n            int x1 = Math.Max(ax1,bx1);\n            int y1 =  Math.Max(ay1,by1);\n            int x2 = Math.Min(ax2,bx2);\n            int y2 = Math.Min(ay2,by2);\n            overlap=(x2-x1)*(y2-y1);\n        }\n        \n        return area1 + area2 - overlap;\n    }\n}","compare_result":"","title_slug":"rectangle-area","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":73}
